entries.en: Added background agent notifications in `claude agents` — sessions that need input or finish now fire the `Notification` hook (`agent_needs_input` / `agent_completed`)
entries.zh: 在“claude Agents”中添加了后台代理通知 - 需要输入或完成的会话现在会触发`Notification`挂钩（`agent_needs_input`/`agent_completed`）

entries.en: Added `/dataviz` skill for chart and dashboard design guidance with a runnable color-palette validator
entries.zh: 添加了`/dataviz`技能，用于使用可运行的调色板验证器来指导图表和仪表板设计

entries.en: Gateway: added Claude Platform on AWS (anthropicAws) as an upstream provider; model-not-found responses now advance the failover chain
entries.zh: 网关：新增 Claude Platform on AWS（anthropicAws）作为上游提供商；“找不到模型”的响应现在会推进故障切换链

entries.en: Subagents now run in the background by default, so Claude keeps working while they run and is notified when they finish (previously a gradual rollout)
entries.zh: 子代理现在默认在后台运行，Claude 可在它们运行时继续工作，并在完成时收到通知（此前为逐步推出）

entries.en: Background agents launched from `claude agents` now commit, push, and open a draft PR when they finish code work in a worktree, instead of stopping to ask
entries.zh: 从“claude Agents”启动的后台代理现在在完成工作树中的代码工作时提交、推送和打开草稿 PR，而不是停下来询问

entries.en: The built-in Explore agent now inherits the main session's model (capped at opus) instead of running on haiku
entries.zh: 内置的 Explore 代理现在继承主会话的模型（最高到 opus），不再固定使用 haiku

entries.en: Subagents and context compaction now inherit the session's extended thinking configuration, improving output quality on delegated tasks
entries.zh: 子代理和上下文压缩现在会继承会话的扩展思考配置，委派任务的输出质量更高

entries.en: Improved focus mode: subagents launched in a turn now appear in its activity summary, and completed background notifications fold into a single count
entries.zh: 改进专注模式：本轮启动的子代理会出现在活动摘要中，已完成的后台通知合并为一个计数

entries.en: Improved syntax highlighting accuracy in code blocks, diffs, and file previews by upgrading to highlight.js 11
entries.zh: 改进代码块、差异和文件预览的语法高亮准确度：升级到 highlight.js 11

entries.en: Keyboard shortcut hints now show opt/cmd instead of alt/super when connected from a Mac over SSH
entries.zh: 通过 SSH 从 Mac 连接时，快捷键提示现在显示 opt/cmd，而不是 alt/super

entries.en: Improved API retry UX: the error reason is now shown after the second attempt, and a status page link replaces the spinner tip when the API is overloaded
entries.zh: 改进 API 重试体验：第二次尝试后会显示出错原因；API 过载时，用状态页链接代替加载提示

entries.en: `/login` now opens the sign-in dialog from the `claude agents` view instead of saying it isn't available
entries.zh: `/login` 现在会从 `claude agents` 视图打开登录对话框，而不再提示不可用

entries.en: Subagents now treat messages from the agent that launched them as normal task direction; an agent's message is still never treated as the user's approval
entries.zh: 子代理现在把启动它的代理发来的消息视为正常的任务指示；但代理的消息仍然绝不会被当作用户的批准

entries.en: Fixed brief network drops mid-response aborting the turn — transient errors like ECONNRESET now retry with backoff instead of failing
entries.zh: 修复了短暂的网络中止响应中止转弯的问题 - 像 ECONNRESET 这样的暂时性错误现在会通过退避重试，而不是失败

entries.en: Fixed excessive background classifier requests when sandboxed processes repeatedly accessed the same network host
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒进程重复访问同一网络主机时过多的后台分类器请求

entries.en: Fixed background tasks in web, desktop, and VS Code task panels getting stuck on "Running" after they finish or after resuming a session
entries.zh: 修复了 Web、桌面和 VS Code 任务面板中的后台任务在完成后或恢复会话后卡在“正在运行”的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a teammate that dies on an API error now reports "failed" to the lead, and messaging a stuck teammate wakes it to retry immediately
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：因 API 错误而死亡的队友现在向领导报告“失败”，并且向卡住的队友发送消息会唤醒其立即重试

entries.en: Fixed the `/diff` panel not refreshing when you switch branches or commit outside the session
entries.zh: 修复在会话外切换分支或提交后，`/diff` 面板不会刷新的问题

entries.en: Fixed markdown tables overflowing and wrapping their right border when rendered in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下渲染时 Markdown 表格溢出并包裹其右边框的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude Platform on AWS and Mantle sessions dead-ending with "Please run /login" when the STS token expires — `awsAuthRefresh` now runs automatically
entries.zh: 修复了 AWS 上的 Claude Platform 和 Mantle 会话在 STS 令牌过期时出现“请运行 /login”的死胡同 — `awsAuthRefresh` 现在会自动运行

entries.en: Fixed "no route to host" for local-network hosts in macOS background agent sessions by declaring Local Network entitlements
entries.zh: 通过声明本地网络权利，修复了 macOS 后台代理会话中本地网络主机的“无主机路由”问题

entries.en: Fixed `/desktop` failing with "Cannot determine working directory" after entering and exiting a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了进入和退出工作树后`/desktop`失败并显示“无法确定工作目录”的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents repeatedly showing "Reconnecting…" every ~52 seconds on macOS while the agents view was open
entries.zh: 修复了代理视图打开时，后台代理在 macOS 上每约 52 秒重复显示“正在重新连接...”的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing `←` inside `claude attach <id>` exiting to the shell instead of opening the agent view
entries.zh: 修复了在“claude Attach <id>”内按`←`退出 shell 而不是打开代理视图的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --bg` silently creating an unattachable session when combined with `--print`/`-p`; the conflicting flags are now rejected up front
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --bg`与`--print`/`-p`组合时静默创建不可附加会话的问题；冲突的标志现在被预先拒绝

entries.en: Fixed the workflow progress view dropping the earliest agents from the list while the phase counter stayed correct in SDK and desktop-app sessions
entries.zh: 修复在 SDK 和桌面应用会话中，工作流进度视图丢弃列表中最早的智能体、而阶段计数器仍正确的问题

entries.en: Fixed `.claude/rules/` conditional rules not loading when the target file is reached via a symlinked path
entries.zh: 修复了通过符号链接路径到达目标文件时不加载`.claude/rules/`条件规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cmd+click not opening URLs in fullscreen mode in Warp on macOS
entries.zh: 修复了 Cmd+click 在 macOS 上的 Warp 中无法以全屏模式打开 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed double-click word selection in fullscreen mode to select the entire URL including the scheme
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式下双击单词选择以选择整个 URL（包括方案）的问题

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not auto-allowing read-only tool calls when a session starts in plan mode
entries.zh: 修复了当会话在计划模式下启动时，计划模式不会自动允许只读工具调用

entries.en: Fixed `/branch` deriving its default fork name from the compaction summary instead of the first real prompt
entries.zh: 修复了从压缩摘要而不是第一个真实提示中派生默认分叉名称的`/branch`

entries.en: Removed the `/agents` wizard; ask Claude to create or manage subagents, or edit `.claude/agents/` directly
entries.zh: 移除 `/agents` 向导；请让 Claude 创建或管理子代理，或直接编辑 `.claude/agents/`

entries.en: Claude in Chrome is now generally available
entries.zh: Chrome 中的 Claude 现已全面可用
